name: Open Questions

brand.tagline: What science honestly does not know yet: the big open questions, where the evidence leans today, and how that lean has moved. Run on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: An atlas of open questions by field, each with the competing answers, the best evidence for each, a graded lean and a history of how the lean moved. A weekly beat watches review and preprint feeds for each question, files new evidence on the entry and moves the lean only when graded evidence moves it, recording why.
goals: atlas of 30 open questions with graded leans
links into Unlearn and Practical Solutions when a question settles
positioning: Knowing what is not yet known is as useful as knowing what is; a map of open questions, with where the evidence leans and how fast it moves, is missing from public knowledge. Same shape as Unlearn and Practical Solutions: guess first, graded evidence, a loop that keeps checking, no accounts or trackers.

system_test.loop: A weekly beat watches review and preprint feeds for each question, files new evidence on the entry and moves the lean only when graded evidence moves it, recording why.
system_test.measure: share of questions whose evidence feed was read within 7 days, target 1.0; lean changes logged with graded evidence
system_test.upkeep: new studies, data releases and evaluations arrive every week, sources rot and entries must be re-graded
system_test.run_cost: 5 USD a month for the back end

depth.thesis: Knowing what is not yet known is as useful as knowing what is; a map of open questions, with where the evidence leans and how fast it moves, is missing from public knowledge.
depth.corpus: An atlas of open questions by field, each with the competing answers, the best evidence for each, a graded lean and a history of how the lean moved.
depth.loop: A weekly beat watches review and preprint feeds for each question, files new evidence on the entry and moves the lean only when graded evidence moves it, recording why.
depth.returns: Readers record their own lean and see questions move toward an answer; a question that closes becomes an Unlearn or Practical Solutions entry.
horizon: atlas of 30 open questions with graded leans
links into Unlearn and Practical Solutions when a question settles
depth.hook: Pick your lean on a live question, then see where the evidence leans and how it moved. Knowing you hold a minority view, or that nobody knows yet, is the hook.
depth.public_good: Honest public knowledge of what is not known protects people from false certainty and points students and funders at questions worth answering.
